day_shape: 94 items: US sanctions 9 Hizballah enablers including Iran's Beirut ambassador, Rubio-Cooper call on Hormuz, 27-nation Multinational Military Mission joint statement, House GOP delays war-powers vote, CENTCOM reports 94 vessels redirected enforcing Iran blockade.

threads.label: US sanctions Hezbollah enablers in Lebanon
threads.summary: The State Department and OFAC designated nine individuals enabling Hezbollah, including Iran's ambassador to Beirut Mohammad Reza Raouf Sheibani, with corresponding Federal Register notice. Iran's foreign ministry and Hezbollah issued statements condemning the action as support for Israeli aggression.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz blockade and coalition
threads.summary: A 27-nation joint statement on the Multinational Military Mission for the Strait of Hormuz was published by UK MoD, while CENTCOM reported 94 commercial vessels redirected and 4 disabled enforcing the Iran blockade. Rubio told press a Hormuz tolling system would make any Iran deal unfeasible, raised in his call with UK Foreign Secretary Cooper.

threads.label: US-Iran negotiations and uranium stockpile
threads.summary: Trump vowed the US will recover Iran's enriched uranium stockpile despite Tehran's refusal, while Pakistani diplomats held another round of talks with Iran's foreign minister. Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson said negotiations are focused on ending the war on all fronts, rejecting media speculation on nuclear details.

threads.label: US House Iran war-powers vote delayed
threads.summary: Republicans delayed a US House vote to halt the Iran war that was reportedly on the verge of passing. Regime outlets amplified Politico and CNN coverage framing the cancellation as preventing a scandal for Trump.

threads.label: Iran war military costs and posture
threads.summary: Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported the US used over half its THAAD interceptor stockpile defending Israel during the Iran war, double the IDF's figure. Defa Press amplified a Bloomberg claim that Iran destroyed more than 24 US MQ-9 Reaper drones — around 20% of inventory — and the Jerusalem Post cited Israeli intelligence warning of a possible Iranian surprise attack on Gulf states and Israel.

threads.label: Gaza ceasefire and Board of Peace at UNSC
threads.summary: The UN Security Council heard Gaza's High Representative on the Board of Peace call the ceasefire 'far from perfect', with envoy Mladenov urging the UNSC to disarm Hamas and publishing a roadmap for Trump's peace plan. UK Chargé d'Affaires James Kariuki delivered a statement saying Israel must take urgent steps on the humanitarian situation in Gaza.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging on Raisi anniversary
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted messages marking the second anniversary of Ebrahim Raisi's death, praising him as an alumnus of the Khomeini-Khamenei school and a 'compassionate, people-oriented' president. Further posts addressed population increase as a strategic issue and called on officials to define a role for the 'resurrected people'.
